Sidebar session titles and subtitles are cut short with ellipses (e.g. 'Context · J11 memory journ…', 'Context · Mesh journey fixt…'). This is intentional, and they're outside the main settings content.
The 'Not set' status under 'GitHub token' and the 'CONNECTED' label are small and fairly dim, though still readable.
